integrity: Analytical argument checked against exact construction and 32550 supplementary finite assertions. No empirical validation, historical priority not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Fixed continuous total budget, identical unit costs, positive fixed generalist rates, one specialist target, linear independent Poisson encounter intensities, and a weighted-miss objective; not a dynamic discounted-cost or field-calibrated theorem. Quantitative gains can be small near switching budgets.
title: One activation window for a specialist pest detector: a sharp three-pest example
